Professional Experience / Work History  
As a Senior Tech Lead at RetailNova, I spearheaded the architecture of a serverless inventory system that reduced API latency by 40% while scaling to handle 1.2M daily transactions. This involved integrating AWS Lambda with DynamoDB and implementing real-time analytics pipelines. Prior to that, I led a microservices refactor at ShopifyClone, transitioning monolithic architectures to Go-based services orchestrated via Kubernetes. The overhaul improved deployment efficiency by 60% and reduced downtime to under 0.5%. At EcomExpress, I designed payment gateways using Python and PostgreSQL, supporting 300K+ transactions monthly. My work there emphasized secure, high-throughput systems with PCI-DSS compliance.  

Technical Skills / Technologies  
Python, Go, REST API design, AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, API Gateway), Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, System design, Team leadership, Agile/Scrum, Cross-team collaboration, Stakeholder communication, Technical writing.
